en: Dependent on a state with a past object, a state with a non-past object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state with a past object, a state with a non-future object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state with a past object, a state with a non-present object arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state with a past object...
Dependent on [a state] not having a past object, states that do not have a present object arise by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).

Dependent on a state having a past object, states that do not have a future object and do not have a present object arise by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state having a past object, states that do not have a past object and do not have a future object...

And states with past objects arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state with a past object, there arise states that do not have past objects, nor future objects, nor present objects, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one;
under object condition there are nine... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
